notes: The answers say outright that this is a simple test place — touch a keycap and it clicks — with no scoring, progression or number going up, so there is no game type to match and this is No Genre rather than an invented clicker. It is emphatically not P5: a baseplate with a giant keyboard is real 3D geometry, and the player touches the keycaps with their avatar, so nothing is a SET either. Every axis sits at its default, which routes P0: a small exterior baseplate, one surface, one zone, nothing that has to be structurally valid, and no volumetric movement. None of the three no-genre presets fits a deliberately bare test place, so I emitted none and kept only landmark-focal for the giant keyboard itself, bent to roughly twelve keycaps on a small baseplate, plus a spawn placed on the plate facing the keys; the click behaviour on touch is mechanics rather than layout.
